title: platform.diagnostics_round_trip_recorded v1
description: Emitted inside the transaction that records a Phase 00 diagnostics round trip. It exists to prove the outbox path end to end: written atomically with the state change, claimed by a worker after commit, and consumed exactly once in effect despite forced duplicate delivery. It carries no personal or clinical data and it has no production consumer.

diagnostics_id.description: Identifier of the synthetic diagnostics record committed in the same transaction.

label.description: Machine-generated slug identifying a test run. Lowercase, starts with a letter, and contains no spaces, so it cannot carry a sentence. Enforced at the API edge, here, and by a database CHECK, which additionally rejects any run of 10 or more digits so a national ID or phone number cannot ride along inside a valid slug.

echo_delay_ms.description: Artificial delay the consumer applies before marking the event processed. Used by timing and lease-expiry tests.

recorded_at.description: UTC instant the diagnostics record was written, assigned inside the transaction.
